name: @mandusec/eval
description: Mandu red-team + benign-utility eval corpus. A declarative YAML corpus (attacks/ + benign/) ported from adfi-openclaw's test/benchmark (injection-tasks, attack-templates, injection-vectors, user-tasks) and re-targeted at Mandu's agent surface (Claude Code / Codex tools: Read / Bash / WebFetch / WebSearch). An attack case pairs a benign carrier (file/url/exec input) with an embedded injected instruction (delimiter-escape framing + attacker intent) and a security_check (regex patterns whose presence in an agent tool call means the attack SUCCEEDED). A benign task pairs a prompt + tool with file/content/response assertions. lib/corpus.ts owns the schema types, YAML loaders, and the (currently flat) case builder, structured so an attack×framing×vector cross-product can grow later (mirroring adfi's test/lib/e2e-defs.ts buildE2ETests). Owns no runner/oracle — those are downstream; this package only loads + validates the corpus.
